Class PoseFilterStats

java.lang.Object
yall.filter.PoseFilterStats
public class PoseFilterStats extends Object
Counts of what a camera's pose filter accepted and rejected, and how spread out the accepted poses are.

The spread is how to find a camera's standard deviations: hold the robot still where it sees tags, reset(), wait a few seconds, then read getStdDevs(). getSuggestedBaseStdDevs(double) turns that into the base standard deviations for VisionPoseFilter.withStdDevs(Matrix, Matrix, double).
